import struct

data += struct.pack('<I', 0)

cc = cc_seed % 2
print(f'contentChecksum: seed={cc_seed}, result={cc}')
bc_seed = retrieve32()
bc = bc_seed % 2
print(f'blockChecksum: seed={bc_seed}, result={bc}')
cl_seed = retrieve32()
cl = (cl_seed % 16) - 3
print(f'compressionLevel: seed={cl_seed}, result={cl}')

fd_seed = retrieve32()
fd = fd_seed % 2
print(f'favorDecSpeed: seed={fd_seed}, result={fd}')
print(f'Remaining bytes (size): {producer_size}')
"
